class.name: RenderEffectSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for the quality of SSAO, SSIL, SDFGI, VoxelGI, volumetric fog, subsurface scattering and depth of field, and for player switches that turn environment effects off.

method.name: set_environment_ignored
method.description: If [param ignored] is [code]true[/code], [param environment] is not affected by the [code]allow_*[/code] switches and the brightness, contrast and saturation of this domain (see [method RenderingServer.environment_set_ignore_global_overrides]), for example the environment of a menu background or a character preview. The flag belongs to the resource: every node that uses it is excluded.

signal.name: allow_fog_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member RenderEffectSettings.allow_fog] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those.

signal.name: allow_glow_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member RenderEffectSettings.allow_glow] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it for effects the game draws itself instead of the [Environment] glow.
